## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9d13278ddab087a998a58495abe9fdda109beced`
Local-runs: none
Scope: scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs, scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs + none

`reviewFace` returns no `hits` on this file list (ungoverned); the three files above are judged as the contract files, per the brief. Read: card #33603 with every comment, PR #33711 body and file list, the net diff against the merge base `d4e3dcc6` (3 files, +330 −37), item F of the delegation review, and the check-runs on the head. Cited code read at the head, not reviewed: `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (`runGuard`, `readLowRiskTier`, `recordVerdict`, `lowRiskRecordVerdict`, the three readers), `record-recognisers.mjs` (`regenCarry`), `contract-review.md` lines 33 to 38, and PR #33686's diff of `fleet-write/execute.mjs`.

Check-runs on the head when this was written: 24 success, 23 skipped, 0 failed; `Test Core (1/8)` still in progress. Every lint family, both type-check families, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, the PR-body guards and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are complete and green. The seat confirms the last shard before landing.

### ① Derived judgments

- Verifier accept set, narrowed: an `advisorModel` present, not null and off the tier refuses. Right; null and absent pass, a non-string value refuses (closed).
- Verifier accept set, narrowed: any assistant turn calling `Agent`, `Task`, `Workflow` or `SendMessage` refuses. Right for the failure it targets (a delegating session passing its own at-tier transcript for a review an off-tier sub-agent ran, the 11-15 shape). It also closes the in-seat route for any session that ever dispatched an agent; see N1.
- Verifier accept set, unchanged: a model value with a context suffix still refuses (closed, with a measured reason); a cleanly cut prefix still passes (closed with a reason: no honest run writes one, and the record is the last turn's text). Both closures are sound against the card's "fixed with a pin row or closed with a reason".
- Audit, new states `pass`, `breach`, `tier-h`, `not-measured`; `pass` and `breach` rows leave the maintainer's list for their own section. Right in shape; wrong in two cases, S1 and S2.
- Audit exit: `not-measured` now makes the sweep INCOMPLETE (exit 2). Right. A `breach` row leaves the exit at 0: the tool stays report-only, which the PR says and the card does not forbid.
- `--json` gains `entries[].arm` (additive). Right.
- Both dispatches moved from a module-scope `await` to `.then`: a thrown `main` still exits 1, a self-test that misses its verdict still exits 1. `main` runs its synchronous prefix at the same point in module evaluation as before, so no new TDZ exposure. Right.
- `post-stamped.mjs`: self-test only (a spawn timeout and a detail helper). A timed-out child has status null, so the case fails: the timeout path is closed. Right.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: three `scripts/pm/` tools, nothing published, `Check Changeset` green. `Clause-②: no` is right: no accept set of a published surface moves. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev report carries no `open_questions`. Its three out-of-scope items and the header wording, judged:

- Raw relay `comment` / `comment_edit` not judged for tier: deferral sound (the code is in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/`, outside this card's surface and on the files PR #33686 holds). It is neither fixed nor closed with a reason, so the card's Part 3 is met only once it has a card of its own. The PR body says `Fixes #33603`: the seat files that card before this lands.
- `contract-review.md` session-evidence line: deferral sound (a governed file at its ceiling, outside the surface, owing its own review). After this lands, line 37 still tells a seat reviewing in-seat to pass its own session file, and the verifier refuses that file for any seat that dispatched an agent. The seat cards the rule line; see N1.
- Workflow owner filed for the maintainer: deferral sound; the contract asks for an owner PROPOSED and bars a `.github/workflows` change here. The reasoning (the audited seat should not own its audit) holds. The interim weekly patrol has no rule carrier (`lanes/skills.md` is at 35 of 35), so it binds nobody until the workflow card exists: the seat files it with this landing.
- Header "not path-only from #33540": at this head and on `main`, `governedReviewPlan` is path-only (it has no `lowRisk` parameter); PR #33686 adds one and is open, mergeable. The sentence is true once #33686 lands and reads as a present-tense claim before that. See N2: land this after #33686 and the wording is true with no head move.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix. Two should-fix, both in `readArmLanding`, both owing a delta review.

**S1 (should-fix) — a landing the maintainer cleared is reported as a BREACH.** In the queue, an entry the arm reads Tier S is cleared by an authorized approval or an authorized enqueue BEFORE the record leg runs (`runGuard`: `if (approvals...state === 'approved') continue; if (enqueues...state === 'authorized') continue;`), so such a landing never needed a record. `readArmLanding` reads neither: every landing the arm reads Tier S without a same-head at-tier PASS record is `breach`, printed under "NOT the maintainer's to recognise ... file it as an incident". Reachable today: a skills wording PR the maintainer approves or enqueues himself with no seat record, a record on an older head carried by his approval, and every pre-arm skills landing inside the first weekly windows (the PR body concedes the arm reads pre-arm landings; #33632 escaped only because it had a record). The jsdoc claim "the audit cannot read a landing differently from the queue that let it in" is false for these. The fix is small and stays one reader: the timeline is already in hand, and the guard exports `enqueuerFromTimeline` / `authorizedEnqueueVerdict`, `makeReviewReader` and `authorizedApprovalVerdict`; an entry either one clears is the maintainer's merge and stays on his list with that reason. Pin rows: an authorized enqueue with no record, an authorized approval with no record.

**S2 (should-fix) — the record's head is never tied to the landed commit.** The PR is taken from the commit subject (`pullNumberFromSubject`), the head from that PR NOW, and nothing checks that this PR produced this commit: neither `merged` nor `merge_commit_sha === entry.sha` is read. A commit on `main` whose subject ends with the number of an earlier arm PR that holds a PASS record reads `pass` and leaves the maintainer's list, provided its own paths fit the allowlist. That is the direct-push case the post-merge audit exists for (the queue catches everything that went through the queue). Also, a named PR that was closed unmerged has `merged_at` null, so the created-at filter is off and every comment counts. The fix: carry `merge_commit_sha` (and `merged_at` not null) off the attribution read the row already pays for; a mismatch is `not-measured` or `breach`, never `pass`. One pin row each.

Nits (no effect on a correct, honest run; follow-up or accepted deviation):

- **N1** The sub-agent refusal's reason says "pass that agent's own transcript". For a seat reviewing in-seat after dispatching unrelated agents that advice is wrong; the remedy there is to run the review in a sub-agent at the tier. Wording, plus the `contract-review.md` line the seat carries.
- **N2** The "from #33540" header sentence: true only after PR #33686 lands. Order the landings; no edit needed.
- **N3** `SUB_AGENT_TOOLS` is an exact-name deny list. A skill that forks into a sub-agent and connector tools that message another thread or session are not on it. Not measurable from this seat; a follow-up card to measure what such a run writes.
- **N4** A comment created before the landing and edited after it counts (only `created_at` is read). With S1 fixed this matters only for a deliberate edit; printing "edited after landing" on the row from `updated_at` would cost nothing.
- **N5** A git-side read that fails inside the arm (the diff-tree status, a changeset's text, the fork predicate) folds into `tier-h` with a reason, not `not-measured`, so the sweep stays complete; and `armCell` prints only the first two reasons, which can hide that one. The header's "a read that fails is NOT MEASURED" overstates it.
- **N6** `baseRef` here is the landed commit's first parent; the queue used the merge group's base. For the second PR of a group the carry test compares against a different base. Fails toward `breach` at worst.

Held against the break list: a record on another head, below the tier, unsigned, FAIL, or posted after the landing is a `breach` (pinned, and each ablation went red per the PR body); a carried record is re-judged by the guard's own `lowRiskRecordVerdict`; unread pull, timeline or thread is `not-measured` and exit 2; an off-tier advisor, a nested reviewer and a delegating session refuse; the spawn timeout fails closed.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-sgww6y`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb`

**VERDICT: PASS**

<sub>Adopted by the seat 2026-11-15T07:15Z · isolated sub-agent at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (served model verified by the seat) · Ruling-ref: Leehom card cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFhuiZmTH8VFgMmHRmpiGAb, option A, tapped 2026-11-14T15:37Z</sub>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `42323f341b198c6c0625ac74f6ffd3eea8265c6b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs, scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs + none

DELTA review from `9d13278ddab087a998a58495abe9fdda109beced` (record 6890932729: PASS, should-fix S1 and S2, nits N1 to N6) to this head. The branch was rebased from `d4e3dcc6` onto main `5604aeb0`; main's moves between the two bases touch none of the three files, so the file-to-file diff of the two heads is the PR's own net change: `check-governed-merges.mjs` (the S1, S2 and N4 hunks, nine pin rows, battery floor 27 to 36), `verify-review-tier.mjs` (the N1 wording and one pin row, floor 6 to 7), `post-stamped.mjs` unchanged. `reviewFace` returns no `hits` (ungoverned); the three files are judged as the contract files, as in the prior record. Read: card #33603 and its five comments, the PR body and file list, the net diff against main, the prior record, and the check-runs on this head. Cited code read at this head, not reviewed: `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (`entrySatisfied`, `runGuard`, `authorizedApprovalVerdict`, `enqueuerFromTimeline`, `authorizedEnqueueVerdict`, `recordVerdict`, `recordPassVerdict`, `lowRiskRecordVerdict`, `recordAuthorTrusted`, the four readers) and `fleet-write/execute.mjs` on main. Read over REST, read-only: the timelines and merge fields of #33555, #33632, #33668, #33616, #33679, #33686 and #33687, and the record comments on six of them.

Check-runs on this head when this was written: 45 runs; 13 success, 22 skipped, 0 failed, 10 still in progress. Pending: `Test Core (1/8)`, `Test Core (2/8)`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates`. Complete and green: `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check PR Size`, the PR-body guards, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · scoped · query-options erasure`. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` are the families that run these files' self-tests in CI: the seat confirms them before landing.

### ① Derived judgments

- **S1: closed.** `readArmLanding` now runs approval, then enqueue, then the record, the order of `entrySatisfied` and of `runGuard`'s two `continue` lines. Both legs call the guard's own exports (`authorizedApprovalVerdict` on `makeReviewReader` rows, `authorizedEnqueueVerdict(enqueuerFromTimeline(...))` on the timeline already fetched); `ARM_READER_EXPORTS` names them, so a rename is NOT MEASURED. No predicate is restated. A cleared landing returns `cleared` with `by` and `who`; `renderReport` lists apart only `pass` and `breach`, so `cleared` stays on the maintainer's list, and `armCell` prints who cleared it. Pinned: approval, enqueue, the report row, and three controls (seat-account enqueue, post-landing approval, unauthorized approval).
- **The strict-before cut on reviews and events: right.** Measured again on seven queue merges (#33555, #33632, #33668, #33616, #33679, #33686, #33687): every one carries exactly one `added_to_merge_queue` 20 to 50 minutes before the merge, then `merged` and `removed_from_merge_queue` at the very second `merged_at` names, the removal listed after `merged`. Counting events at the merge second would read every queue landing as undetermined (newest queue event a removal); strictly before reads the entry as the merge group saw it. The removal is caused by the merge, so it cannot carry an earlier second than `merged_at`.
- **Is the enqueue always on the timeline, and where does undetermined go?** For a queue landing, yes: the add precedes the group build by construction and was present on all seven. The filtered reading matches the guard's on each re-entry shape: maintainer add, removal, seat re-add reads the seat (unauthorized, the record decides); maintainer add then a removal before the merge with no re-add reads undetermined (that entry left; right). Undetermined and unauthorized fall to the record leg, exactly as in the guard, so undetermined never clears. It reaches BREACH only when no standing record exists either, and a queue landing in that state could not have passed the guard, so that is a true anomaly, not a false one. An event with no `created_at` is dropped; queue events always carry one.
- **S2: closed.** `fetchPullAttribution` carries `merge_commit_sha`. No attribution is `not-measured` (exit 2). `merged_at` null or unparseable is a BREACH naming it; `merge_commit_sha` other than the row's commit (or absent) is a BREACH naming the commit it landed as. All three run after the tier-h returns and before any clearing leg, so a commit that only names a pull is neither `pass` nor `cleared`. The old "no merge time, every row counts" path and its pin row are gone. On the seven live merges `merge_commit_sha` is the commit on main. Pinned: three rows.
- **N1: closed.** The refusal now asks for the transcript of the agent that ran the review and called no other agent, and names both honest routes (a review sub-agent's own file, or a session that ran no other agent). The header bullet agrees. One pin row holds the new phrase in and the old one out. The `contract-review.md` rule line is still the seat's carrier, as the PR body says.
- **N4: closed, stricter than asked; the direction is right.** A row counts only when `created_at` and `updated_at` (falling back to `created_at`) are both at or before `merged_at`; a missing time never counts. A record corrected before the landing still counts. A record edited after the landing is dropped, because REST shows no edit history and an edit can turn a FAIL into a PASS; the audit cannot tell that from a typo fix, so refusing is the only closed reading. Cost measured: all ten record comments read on #33555, #33632, #33668, #33616, #33686, #33687 and this PR have `updated_at` equal to `created_at`, so no live record is affected. See N7 for the wording of the resulting row.
- **N2: closed by the rebase.** `governedReviewPlan` on main (`5604aeb0`, which carries #33686) takes `lowRisk`; the header sentence is true at this head.
- N3, N5, N6: untouched by the delta, still open as nits.
- The delta's own tests moved the roster correctly: `fetchReviews` added to the fake fetchers and to `main`'s counted readers, so review reads count in the lookup total.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` are right. Three `scripts/pm/` tools, nothing published. `--json` gains the `cleared` state and its `by` / `who` fields under `entries[].arm` (additive).

### ③ Boundary flags

- The three seat-carried items of the prior record (the relay raw comment ops card, the `contract-review.md` rule line, the workflow owner card) are unchanged by the delta and still owed with this landing; the PR body still says `Fixes #33603`.
- The PR body's two-minute check (three skills landings `cleared` by an `os-zhuang` enqueue, no BREACH) agrees with the timelines read here: all three were enqueued by `os-zhuang`.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix. One should-fix, new at this head, and two nits.

**S3 (should-fix) — the audit's record leg does not apply the guard's author binding.** Main moved under this branch: #33687 (card #33541) made `runGuard` drop every comment row whose author is not the relay or a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account (`recordAuthorTrusted(row, recognisers.trustedAuthors)`) before the locator reads the thread. `readArmLanding` hands `recordVerdict` every row that passes the time filter, whoever wrote it; the battery's own `record()` rows carry no `user` at all and read `pass`, where the guard would read them absent. So at this head the header's "one reader" and the jsdoc's "the audit cannot read a landing differently from the queue" are false in one leg. Effect: (a) a landing that did not go through the queue (the bypass case the audit exists for) is excused as `pass` by a record body any commenter posted before the merge; (b) a queue landing whose trusted PASS record is followed by an untrusted FAIL-shaped comment reads BREACH, since the locator takes the newest. Not introduced by the dev's hunks, and no regression against main (the sweep has no arm leg there), which is why it is not must-fix; but it is the same class as S2. The fix stays one reader: add `recordAuthorTrusted` to `ARM_READER_EXPORTS`, filter the rows with `recognisers.trustedAuthors` beside the time filter, give the battery's rows the relay login, and pin two rows (an untrusted PASS record is a BREACH; an untrusted FAIL after a trusted PASS changes nothing). The seat either takes it here (one more delta) or files it on this file before landing.

Nits:

- **N7** A record dropped by the edited-after-landing filter produces a BREACH whose reason reads "no `## Contract review` record on its head", the same words as a landing with no record at all. The row tells the reader to file an incident; it should say a record was present and edited after the landing. Wording only; no live record is affected.
- **N8** The approval leg reads the review's state as it is now. An authorized approval given before the landing and dismissed after it reads DISMISSED and no longer clears; the landing then falls to the record leg. Toward BREACH only, and not seen on any landing read here.
- N3, N5, N6 of the prior record stand as written.

Held against the break list for the delta: an enqueue or approval by a seat account, an unauthorized account, or after the landing clears nothing (pinned); an unread review list, timeline, pull or merge is `not-measured` and exit 2 (pinned); a pull closed unmerged or merged as another commit is never `pass` or `cleared` (pinned); a record created or edited after the landing does not count (pinned); the verifier's accept set did not widen (wording and one pin row only).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-sgww6y`
Reviewed-by: `session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c48e9f19a0f6610029f20510e4ad6c970c57374a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs, scripts/pm/verify-review-tier.mjs, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs + none

DELTA review from `42323f341b198c6c0625ac74f6ffd3eea8265c6b` (record 6891274033: PASS, should-fix S3, nits N7 and N8) to this head. The branch was rebased from main `5604aeb0` onto main `48e69596`; main's moves between the two bases touch `check-half-states.mjs`, `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` and `mailbox-open.mjs` only, none of the three files and neither the guard nor the recognisers, so the file-to-file diff of the two heads is the PR's own net change: `check-governed-merges.mjs` alone, 24 lines added and 10 removed (the header sentence, `ARM_READER_EXPORTS`, the `readArmLanding` jsdoc and its row filter, the BREACH reason, the battery's `record()` helper, two new pin rows and one widened, battery floor 36 to 38). `verify-review-tier.mjs` and `post-stamped.mjs` are byte-identical between the two heads. `reviewFace` returns no `hits` (ungoverned); the three files are judged as the contract files, as in the prior records. Read: card #33603 and its five comments, the PR body and file list, the net diff against main (3 files, 412 added, 37 removed), the prior record, and the check-runs on this head. Cited code read at this head, not reviewed: `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (`recordAuthorTrusted`, `loadRecordRecognisers`, the `runGuard` author filter, its #33541 pins) and `check-handover.mjs` (`FLEET_BOT_LOGIN`).

Check-runs on this head when this was written: 43 runs; 7 success, 22 skipped, 1 cancelled, 0 failed, 13 still in progress. Pending: `Plan Test Core shards`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · scoped · query-options erasure`. Complete and green: `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards` (one run green; the cancelled run is its superseded twin), `Auto Label`, `Test UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `filter`. Nothing was run locally, so the new pin rows and the 38 floor are read, not executed: `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates` and `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` are the families that run this file's self-test, and the seat confirms them green before landing.

### ① Derived judgments

- **S3: closed.** `readArmLanding` now filters each thread's rows with `guard.recordAuthorTrusted(r, recognisers.trustedAuthors)` first, then by creation time, then by last edit, and only the survivors reach `recordVerdict`. The predicate is the guard's own export, called through the lazily loaded module; `recordAuthorTrusted` is in `ARM_READER_EXPORTS`, so a rename is NOT MEASURED, never a second parser. No login is typed in this file. The order (author, then time) matches `runGuard`, which drops untrusted rows before any reader sees the thread; an untrusted row can therefore neither be the record nor shadow one, in the audit as in the queue. The header and the jsdoc sentence "one reader" are true again in this leg.
- **The battery rows post as the relay from the live loader.** `RELAY` is `readers.recognisers.trustedAuthors[0]`, read from the real `loadArmReaders()` result, and `record()` stamps `user.login` with it by default. If the loader did not yield it, the fallback string is not a trusted login, every PASS row of the battery reads BREACH and the battery goes red: the fallback cannot make a pin vacuous.
- **Pins, read against the code.** (a) `a-PASS-record-from-an-UNTRUSTED-author-is-not-PASS`: a full at-tier same-head PASS body by `some-commenter` is a BREACH reading no record. (b) `an-UNTRUSTED-FAIL-after-a-trusted-PASS-does-not-shadow-it`: a newer FAIL by `some-commenter` leaves `pass`, and in the same assertion the identical newer FAIL by the relay is a BREACH reading "does not read PASS", so the control proves the first half is the author binding and not the locator ignoring the row. All three shapes the brief names are pinned. Floor arithmetic: two assertions added, one renamed, 36 to 38.
- **Fail closed when `trustedAuthors` cannot be loaded: yes, at three depths, never trust-everyone.** (1) `loadRecordRecognisers` sets `trustedAuthors` to null when `FLEET_BOT_LOGIN` is not a non-empty string and then returns `available: false`, naming it; `readArmLanding` returns `not-measured` on `recognisers.available !== true` before the record leg, and the sweep is INCOMPLETE (exit 2). (2) A guard that fails to load or lacks `recordAuthorTrusted` is `readers.available: false`, also `not-measured`. (3) Were a recogniser set to arrive `available` with no list, `recordAuthorTrusted` requires `Array.isArray(trusted)`, so every row is dropped and the landing is a BREACH. A row with no readable `user.login` is untrusted. A non-array comment read throws inside the `try` and is `not-measured`. The guard pins (1) and (3) itself (`#33541-recordAuthorTrusted-is-exact-on-the-login-and-fails-closed-on-no-list`, `a-loader-that-cannot-read-the-relay-identity-is-unavailable`); see N11 for the audit-side pin.
- **N7: closed.** A trusted row created at or before the landing and edited after it is collected in `editedAfter` and the absent-record BREACH reason now ends "PR comment 900 was edited after the landing, so it does not count" (thread and comment id). Untrusted rows are never named, and a row created after the landing is not named either (it is not an edit). Pinned by the widened row, which requires both the old words and the new clause. See N9 and N10 for its edges.
- **Did the delta break anything? No.** The time filter is the same predicate split in two: created at or before the landing and `updated_at` (falling back to `created_at`) at or before it, a missing time never counting; the prior `every` over the same two values reads identically. The record leg's other states, the approval and enqueue legs, the S2 ties, the report and `--json` are untouched. The live effect of the binding is nil on honest landings: records reach the threads through the relay, whose login is the first trusted author, and `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` are trusted beside it, exactly the set the queue read them with.
- N8 (an approval dismissed after the landing no longer clears) and N3, N5, N6 are untouched by the delta and stand as nits.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` are right. Three `scripts/pm/` tools, nothing published. The delta changes no output shape; only the text of one BREACH reason grows.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The three seat-carried items (the relay raw comment ops card, the `contract-review.md` rule line, the workflow owner card) are unchanged by the delta and still owed with this landing; the PR body still says `Fixes #33603`.
- The PR body was brought in line with the delta (the author binding, the edited-comment wording, 38 cases, 728 assertions, two more ablations). Those counts and ablations are the dev's report; none was re-run here.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix. No should-fix. Three new nits.

- **N9** The edited-after clause is appended only when the record reads `absent`. A landing with an older trusted record that reads FAIL, below tier or unsigned, plus a newer trusted PASS edited after the landing, reads "its record does not read PASS" (or the tier or signature words) with no mention of the dropped row. Toward BREACH only; wording.
- **N10** `editedAfter` names every trusted comment edited after the landing, not only a `## Contract review` record: a relay claim or report comment on the PR or the card that was edited after the merge is named on an absent-record BREACH as "does not count", which can read as if a record had been there.
